title: Unique Formation of a Pentanuclear Lanthanum(III) Thiolate Oxide Cluster via Control of Hydrolysis

synthesis.procedure: Under argon (Schlenk), a hexane (10 mL) solution of HSPh (0.131 mL, 1.28 mmol) was slowly added to a THF (30 mL) solution of [(TMS)2N]3La(μ-Cl)Li(THF)3 (1) (1.13 g, 1.28 mmol). The colorless solution was stirred overnight at ambient temperature, concentrated to dryness in vacuo, extracted with toluene (2 × 10 mL), concentrated to ca. 10 mL, and cooled to −18 °C for several days to give colorless plates of 2·C7H8, which were isolated by filtration, washed with hexane, and dried in vacuo.
synthesis.time: stirred overnight; crystals after several days
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Concentrated to dryness, extracted with toluene, concentrated to ca. 10 mL, cooled to −18 °C; crystals washed with hexane and dried in vacuo.

material_class.structural_family: pentanuclear La5 oxo thiolate cluster with μ4-O La4 tetrahedron

synthesis.procedure: Under argon. Method 1: H2O (2.29 µL, 0.127 mmol) in THF (2 mL) was slowly added to a THF (30 mL) solution of 2 (0.926 g, 0.766 mmol) and anhydrous LiCl (0.033 g, 0.766 mmol). White precipitate formed quickly. The mixture was stirred overnight at room temperature, concentrated to dryness, treated with hexane (10 mL), evaporated to a free-flowing powder, washed with hexane (4 × 5 mL), extracted with hot hexane (15 mL) and toluene (10 mL) at about 35 °C, concentrated to ca. 10 mL, and cooled to 2 °C for several days to give colorless prisms of 3·C7H8 (0.040 g, 5%). Hexane washings afforded byproduct [{(TMS)2N}3La] (5) (0.16 g, 17%) on cooling to −18 °C. Method 2: HSPh (0.150 mL, 1.46 mmol) in hexane (5 mL) was added to 1 (1.287 g, 1.46 mmol) in THF (30 mL), stirred overnight, then treated with H2O (2.63 µL, 0.146 mmol) in THF (2 mL); similar workup gave 3·C7H8 (0.14 g, 19%). Main-text stoichiometry: 1/6 equiv H2O vs 2/LiCl (5%) or 1/10 equiv H2O vs 1/HSPh (19%).

reagents.name: water
reagents.amount: 2.29 µL, 0.127 mmol (method 1); 2.63 µL, 0.146 mmol (method 2); 1/6 or 1/10 equiv in main text

synthesis.time: stirred overnight (each stage); crystals after several days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk techniques under argon; controlled hydrolysis
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Dried in vacuo, hexane trituration/washes, hot hexane/toluene extraction, concentrated, cooled to 2 °C; crystals washed with hexane and dried in vacuo.

synthesis.procedure: Under argon, H2O (3.22 µL, 0.179 mmol) in THF (2 mL) was slowly added to 1 (0.924 g, 1.07 mmol) in THF (30 mL). Precipitate formed within seconds. After stirring overnight at room temperature, HSPh (0.110 mL, 1.07 mmol) in hexane (5 mL) was added and the mixture was stirred one more night. Volatiles were evaporated, the oily residue was triturated with hexane (10 mL), evaporated, extracted with hot hexane (15 mL) and toluene (5 mL) at about 40 °C, filtered, and cooled to 2 °C for several days to give colorless crystals of 4. Main-text conditions: 1 treated first with 1/6 equiv H2O then equimolar HSPh (22% yield).
synthesis.time: stirred overnight after water, then one more night after HSPh; crystals after several days
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Evaporated in vacuo, hexane trituration, hot hexane/toluene extraction, filtration, cooling to 2 °C.
